files.description:
Radiological scans showed blurred outlines of internal organs with visible abnormalities. Originium Particle Tests of the circulatory system indicate Oripathy. The subject is confirmed as Infected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 8%
No major visible symptoms of infection. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.22u/L
Severity of infection remains low, with no major hindrance to motor functions.

A quiet warrior with no particularly memorable traits except for the mask she wears. 
As a result, people tend to overlook the fact that she's there. She doesn't seem to mind though, instead focusing on diligently carrying out every task given to her. 
 Dr. Kal'tsit has praised her as 'the cornerstone of Rhodes Island.'

No one knows when Yato joined Rhodes Island, and no one has ever tried to find out. 
Her presence as a Rhodes Island Operator is taken for granted, but if she were to suddenly disappear one day, it's unclear how many people would actually notice.

Some curious Operators once asked Yato about whether she had a history with Noir Corne, but she didn't provide a straightforward answer.
Like Noir Corne, she is rarely seen without her mask.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hey, Doctor. Do me a favor and just tell me what you need done.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I'll be watching you even when I'm off duty.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hm? Do you need something?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My skin is sensitive to sunlight. So please assign me to nighttime missions, whenever you can.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There's limits to what I'm capable of, but even so, I want to help ease the burden you carry, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I can't help but feel just a little envious when I see how the other Operators fight...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I need no particular reason to fight for you, Doctor. I hope to see an exciting frontline battle someday...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, let me be your guardian, now and forever...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Vanguard Yato here. Are you the one I'm protecting?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Yato has joined the team.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: We're ready to execute your plans, Doctor.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: All Operators, be on alert.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Targets spotted. Get ready for battle.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Understood!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: In a blink of eye!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Prepare yourself!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Haaaaghhh!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Slash you down!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: As long as we follow the Doctor's orders, we won't have any problems.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The Doctor's brilliant command was the key to victory.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Victory is the most welcome news.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I apologize... We failed to execute your plan, Doctor...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Please send me somewhere that sunlight can never touch.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: *Gasp*!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, thank you for always taking care of us.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy holidays, Doctor. Thank you for your work over the past year, and may you continue to guide us this year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, I will be your shield.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Please, accept this humble gift. Yes, of course I remember your birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: A blade needs a sheath. It is a shelter, and a place to return. For me, Rhodes Island is that sheath.
